lang.label: Language
layers.badge.tip: The layers this copy runs behind: the LAN fence, and Standard (runc) or gVisor. The Fleet page changes them.
layers.check.tip: Start a short probe container under gVisor on the earners' network. It must see gVisor's kernel and resolve a name.
layers.cmd.dev_build: This CashPilot UI is a development build, so it cannot pin the command to a release. Run a released image to get it.
layers.cmd.not_shipped: This CashPilot UI image does not carry {name}, so it cannot check the download.
layers.copy_fallback: This page is not on https, so the clipboard is blocked. The command is selected: press Ctrl+C or Cmd+C.
layers.default.label: Runtime for earners you deploy here from now on
layers.default.note: Earners already here keep their runtime.
layers.default.saved: Saved. It applies to earners you deploy here from now on.
layers.earner.confirm:
Run {service} under {runtime}?

This redeploys {service} now. It stops and starts again, usually in under a minute. Its data volume is kept.
layers.earner.saved: {service} runs under {runtime} from its next deploy.
layers.gvisor.install_intro: gVisor puts its own kernel between each earner and this host's kernel. It costs about a fifth of the throughput and six to nine times the CPU. Run this command on the host. It asks before it changes anything, and running containers keep running.
layers.gvisor.undo_note: Switch every earner on this worker back to Standard first. The command refuses while one still runs under gVisor.
layers.proxy.off_tip: This worker holds the raw Docker socket, which is root on the host. The shipped compose files put a socket proxy in front of it.
layers.title: Security layers
layers.vm.inside: This worker runs inside a Secure VM on {host}.
layers.vm.tip: A VM layer for earners is planned. It needs KVM on the host.
layers.why.catalog: {service} must run under {runtime}: its catalog entry says so.
layers.why.install_first: Install gVisor on this host first.
layers.why.missing: gVisor is not installed on this host.
layers.why.no_docker: The worker could not ask Docker which runtimes it has.
layers.why.not_linux: gVisor runs on Linux hosts only.
layers.why.old_worker: This worker is older than security layers. Update it to choose a runtime here.
layers.why.pin_default: CASHPILOT_CONTAINER_RUNTIME on this worker is {runtime}. The variable wins over this page.
layers.why.pin_override: CASHPILOT_CONTAINER_RUNTIME_OVERRIDES on this worker sets {slug}={runtime}. The variable wins over this page.
layers.why.unraid: Unraid cannot run gVisor: it boots from a RAM filesystem that gVisor cannot leave. Run the earners in a VM instead.
